answer: Goal already limits the assert to one stable line, and each subcommand's printed lines are fixed in deskops/cli/commands/*.py, so the executor picks one line per command.

Not all 0: runtime status returns 0 with no Space (deskops/cli/commands/runtime.py:45); attach/stop return 1 (runtime.py:48); workers 0 (runtime.py:138,141); supervise 1 on timeout (runtime.py:105); atoms type 1 in some cases (tests/test_domain_tree.py:113).

Flags are in parser.py: atoms show takes a selector (parser.py:152), runtime supervise takes an agent positional (parser.py:84-89), closeout commit requires --task plus exactly one of --run-dir/--no-run (parser.py:1071-1100); atoms list needs only --root.

tests/test_closeout.py:209-213: git repo with one commit (_make_repo) plus one changed file suffices; main([closeout,commit,--task task-x,--no-run,--reason ...,--paths feature.py]) returns 0 with no task doc or run dir.

Repo precedent is monkeypatch.setattr(deskops.cli.commands.runtime, HerdrClient, FakeHerdrClient) (tests/test_cli.py:2663); test_herdr_runtime.py instead injects runner= into HerdrClient (deskops/runtime/herdr.py:102), unreachable from main(argv), so its mention is misleading.

Resolved Decisions already resolves it: sandbox install uses _make_repo plus subprocess _cli (tests/test_lifecycle_end_to_end.py:22,36,51); only the tested command is in-process. In-process desk install is already used at test_inbox_promote_cli_gaps.py:24.

Required flags are generated from each artifact model via model_cli_fields (parser.py:818-826); primitive adds are parse-time optional (parser.py:759-767, edge --source/--target-node) and create new docs; test_cli.py:2038 shows a working main([add,edge,...]).
Not required. deskops prints failures to stdout (deskops/cli/commands/runtime.py:59), and capsys captures both streams; exit code plus one stdout line satisfies Done When.
Existing convention is task-<slug>.md, one task per file under desk/drawer/tasks/ (e.g. task-rw-f0-reject-ambiguous-selectors.md); AGENTS.md routes new unrouted repo work there.
